hints.title: Convert Lists to Sets
hints.text: Convert each person list of companies into a set for fast subset queries.

hints.title: Subset Verification
hints.text: For person i, check if set i is a subset of set j for any j where len(set[j]) > len(set[i]).

hints.title: Collect Non-Subsets
hints.text: If person i is not a subset of any other person list, include index i in the result list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: maximum company count per person
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing sets without size pruning checks smaller sets against even smaller sets.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set lookups and skipping candidates where len(j) <= len(i) prunes unnecessary subset checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate converts lists to sets and tests issubset against larger candidate lists.
complexity.notes: Indices must be sorted ascending in the returned list.
